units.source_text: 我有些点担心他的状况，就劝他去请医生查喀那检查一下。

en.t: I was somewhat worried about his condition, so I urged him to go and have Doctor Chack examine him.

units.source_text: 可是无论怎么劝说，托喀也不愿意去，而且还怀疑的看着我们俩，说出这种奇怪的话：“

en.t: But no matter how we tried to persuade him, Tok refused to go, and he looked at the two of us suspiciously and said this strange thing: "

units.source_text: 我绝对不是无政府主义者。

en.t: I am absolutely not an anarchist.

units.source_text: 这一点请千万记住。——那么，再见吧。

en.t: Please be absolutely sure to remember that. -- Well then, goodbye.
I will absolutely not go to Chack!"
